responsibility: Provides the SPU target’s small common-target configuration layer, focused on generic optimization and exception defaults rather than machine-option parsing. It initializes gcc_options to enable register renaming by default for SPU’s large register file, raises the PARAM_MAX_PENDING_LIST_LENGTH tuning parameter to better suit that register-rich architecture, selects SJLJ unwinding through TARGET_EXCEPT_UNWIND_INFO, and exports the initialized targetm_common hook table for the rest of the SPU backend.
